provenance.notes: Flagship Strix Halo SoC. Homogeneous Zen 5 design (16x Zen 5, no Zen 5c cores), 16 cores/32 threads. Base Clock 3.0 GHz, Max Boost Clock 5.1 GHz per AMD's spec page. Default TDP is 55W with AMD Configurable TDP (cTDP) range of 45-120W; tdp_w field stores the Default TDP. Includes the full-fat Radeon 8060S integrated GPU (40 RDNA 3.5 CUs). Uses FP11 socket (different package/socket from Ryzen AI 300 series' FP8). Launched Jan 2025.

Announced at CES 2026 (AMD newsroom press release, Jan 5 2026) alongside the Max+ 388, extending the Max+ sub-line below the 395 while retaining the full 40-CU Radeon 8060S iGPU. Homogeneous Zen 5 design, 12 cores/24 threads (two CCDs). Base Clock 3.2 GHz, Max Boost Clock 5.0 GHz per AMD's spec page, corroborated by TechPowerUp, wccftech, and Technobezz launch coverage. Default TDP 55W, cTDP range 45-120W; tdp_w field stores Default TDP. Uses FP11 socket.

Non-Plus tier: same core config as the Max+ 392 (12 cores/24 threads, homogeneous Zen 5, Base Clock 3.2 GHz, Max Boost Clock 5.0 GHz) but paired with the cut-down Radeon 8050S iGPU (32 CUs vs 40 CUs on Max+ SKUs), corroborated by Phoronix review. Default TDP 55W, cTDP range 45-120W; tdp_w field stores Default TDP. Uses FP11 socket.

FALLBACK SOURCING: an AMD-hosted per-SKU spec page (ark-style product page) for this exact model was not surfaced in search results; AMD's own newsroom press release (amd.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-1-5-...) confirms the SKU's existence and Jan 5 2026 CES announcement, but does not itemize clock tables. Clock/core/TDP figures below are corroborated across 3 independent secondary sources (Notebookcheck, TechPowerUp, AllCPUs/nanoreview) which agree: 8 cores/16 threads (homogeneous Zen 5, no Zen 5c), Base Clock 3.6 GHz, Max Boost Clock 5.0 GHz, L2 8MB, L3 32MB, Default TDP 55W with cTDP range 45-120W. Notably pairs the smaller 8-core CCD configuration with the full 40-CU Radeon 8060S iGPU (previously exclusive to the flagship 395), differentiating it from the otherwise identical Ryzen AI Max 385 which uses the cut-down Radeon 8050S. Uses FP11 socket.

Entry-level Strix Halo SKU. Homogeneous Zen 5 design (8x Zen 5, no Zen 5c), 8 cores/16 threads. Base Clock 3.6 GHz, Max Boost Clock 5.0 GHz per AMD's spec page. Default TDP 55W, cTDP range 45-120W; tdp_w field stores Default TDP. Includes the cut-down Radeon 8050S integrated GPU (32 CUs), distinguishing it from the identically-clocked Ryzen AI Max+ 388 which pairs the same 8-core CCD with the full 40-CU Radeon 8060S. Uses FP11 socket. Launched Jan 2025.
